parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. The `MockArtworkService` types in each file are test fixtures scoped to their respective test suites. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a record with `is_test=true` must be treated as a test-fixture and no production refactoring should be applied. Consolidating these mocks would couple unrelated test suites and risk obscuring test-local intent.
